author: Forbes
description:
“AI is supercharging humans, not replacing them.” — Peter Goldsborough, CTO of Rune Technologies. 

From the #Under30Summit main stage, he spoke on how fast AI is evolving and why the real shift is about amplification, not replacement.

In areas like defense, that could mean fewer lives at risk, with technology stepping into roles humans once had to take on.

#ForbesUnder30
